rows.note: Glossary proposal: delivery modalities, meaning the modes of conducting a workshop.

rows.en: The MSP Workshop is designed to be adapted based on the following needs:
rows.ne: MSP कार्यशाला निम्न आवश्यकताहरूका आधारमा अनुकूलन गर्न सकिने गरी तयार गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: The MSP workshop has been prepared so that it can be adapted based on the following needs.

rows.en: • MSP dissemination on a particular context
rows.ne: • कुनै निश्चित सन्दर्भमा MSP को प्रसार
rows.bt: • Dissemination of the MSP in a particular context
rows.note: Glossary proposal: dissemination, meaning planned sharing and distribution of the MSP.

rows.en: • Building capacity to use the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for MHPSS strengthening for different sectors and stakeholders depending on their role and capacities.
rows.ne: • विभिन्न क्षेत्र र सरोकारवालाहरूको भूमिका तथा क्षमताअनुसार MHPSS सुदृढ बनाउन MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज प्रयोग गर्ने क्षमता विकास गर्ने।
rows.bt: • Develop the capacity to use the MHPSS Minimum Service Package to strengthen MHPSS according to the roles and capacities of different sectors and stakeholders.

rows.en: Based on the audience, objectives and available time you can opt to facilitate all core modules in this manual or a selection of modules.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरू, उद्देश्यहरू र उपलब्ध समयका आधारमा तपाईंले यस पुस्तिकाका सबै मुख्य मोड्युलहरू वा छानिएका मोड्युलहरूको सहजीकरण गर्ने विकल्प रोज्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: Based on the participants, objectives and available time, you can choose the option of facilitating all the main modules or selected modules in this booklet.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: module, meaning a distinct instructional unit within the workshop; core module denotes a principal unit. The Nepali adds 'a few', restricting the selected modules to a small number; the source allows a selection without that restriction.

rows.en: The following table provides guidance on selecting the best modality for your audience.
rows.ne: तलको तालिकाले तपाईंका सहभागीहरूका लागि सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त सञ्चालन विधि छनोट गर्न मार्गदर्शन प्रदान गर्छ।
rows.bt: The table below provides guidance for selecting the most appropriate method of conducting the workshop for your participants.
rows.note: Uses the proposed workshop delivery modality terminology introduced above.
Uses the proposed module terminology introduced above.

rows.en: Build capacity of actors to use the MSP to strengthen MHPSS programming
rows.ne: MHPSS कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन सुदृढ बनाउन MSP प्रयोग गर्ने सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूको क्षमता विकास गर्ने।
rows.bt: Develop the capacity of relevant actors to use the MSP to strengthen MHPSS programme planning and implementation.

rows.en: Humanitarian actors implementing or intending to implement MHPSS activities who are not MHPSS experts
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गरिरहेका वा कार्यान्वयन गर्ने मनसाय भएका तर MHPSS का विशेषज्ञ नभएका मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू
rows.bt: Actors involved in humanitarian work who are implementing or intend to implement MHPSS activities but are not MHPSS specialists

rows.en: Humanitarian actors in sectors/AoR supporting MHPSS activities (but not implementing MHPSS directly (e.g. shelter, WASH, CCCM, Mine Action, FSL).
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने तर MHPSS प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा कार्यान्वयन नगर्ने, क्षेत्र/AoR (जस्तै: आश्रय, खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH), CCCM, बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, FSL) मा रहेका मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू।
rows.bt: Parties engaged in humanitarian work in sectors/AoR (such as: shelter, drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), CCCM, landmine-related work, FSL) that support MHPSS activities but do not directly implement MHPSS.
rows.note: The source has unbalanced parentheses, leaving the attachment of the examples formally unresolved; the draft treats them as examples of sectors/AoR and preserves the distinction between supporting MHPSS activities and directly implementing MHPSS.

rows.en: • Module 5 can be abridged for this audience given that they don’t require the same level of understanding as the actors who implement MHPSS activities. Exercises to remove: Matching real activities to the MSP; reviewing one activity and its core actions. • In-person or online
rows.ne: • यी सहभागीहरूलाई MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूलाई जत्तिकै गहन बुझाइ आवश्यक नपर्ने भएकाले मोड्युल 5 संक्षिप्त बनाउन सकिन्छ। हटाउनुपर्ने अभ्यासहरू: वास्तविक गतिविधिहरूलाई MSP सँग मिलाउने; एउटा गतिविधि र त्यसका मुख्य कार्यहरू समीक्षा गर्ने। • प्रत्यक्ष उपस्थितिमा वा अनलाइन
rows.bt: • Module 5 can be shortened because these participants do not need as in-depth an understanding as the relevant actors who implement MHPSS activities. Exercises to be removed: matching actual activities with the MSP; reviewing one activity and its key actions. • In person or online
rows.note: Uses the proposed module terminology introduced above.

rows.en: Build capacity of MHPSS actors to use the MSP to strengthen MHPSS programming.
rows.ne: MHPSS कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन सुदृढ बनाउन MSP प्रयोग गर्ने MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूको क्षमता विकास गर्ने।
rows.bt: Develop the capacity of MHPSS-related actors to use the MSP to strengthen MHPSS programme planning and implementation.

rows.en: MHPSS actors e.g. MHPSS Technical Advisors, MHPSS TWG co-chairs, MHPSS Surge Roster members.
rows.ne: MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू, जस्तै: MHPSS प्राविधिक सल्लाहकार, MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) का सह-अध्यक्षहरू, MHPSS Surge Roster का सदस्यहरू।
rows.bt: MHPSS-related actors, for example: MHPSS technical advisers, co-chairs of the MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG), members of the MHPSS Surge Roster.
rows.note: Glossary proposal: MHPSS Surge Roster, meaning a roster of personnel available for rapid deployment. The English label is retained pending agreement on terminology.

rows.en: • Discuss how to adapt and disseminate each module and activity for the context • Consider adding a brief session on different ways to disseminate the MSP (including time to plan for dissemination) • Consider a follow-up session to guide participants on their dissemination plans/ adaptations to their context. • In-person or online
rows.ne: • प्रत्येक मोड्युल र गतिविधिलाई सन्दर्भअनुसार कसरी अनुकूलन र प्रसार गर्ने भन्नेबारे छलफल गर्नुहोस्। • MSP प्रसार गर्ने विभिन्न तरिकाबारे छोटो सत्र थप्ने विषयमा विचार गर्नुहोस् (प्रसारको योजना बनाउने समयसहित)। • सहभागीहरूलाई उनीहरूको प्रसार योजना/आफ्नो सन्दर्भअनुसार गर्ने अनुकूलनबारे मार्गदर्शन गर्न अनुवर्ती सत्र राख्ने विषयमा विचार गर्नुहोस्। • प्रत्यक्ष उपस्थितिमा वा अनलाइन
rows.bt: • Discuss how to adapt and disseminate each module and activity according to the context. • Consider adding a short session on different ways to disseminate MSP (including time to plan dissemination). • Consider holding a follow-up session to guide participants on their dissemination plan/adaptation to their own context. • In person or online
rows.note: Uses the proposed module and dissemination terminology introduced above. The Nepali makes including planning time a separate imperative. In the source, that time is part of the session whose addition is only to be considered; the revision keeps it within that scope.
